tools.name: fresh402_register
tools.description: Create or retrieve a free Fresh402 baseline and persistent watch_id. Existing baselines are returned without refetching, so this tool cannot be used as a free repeated change check.

tools.name: fresh402_check
tools.description: Check whether a registered or caller-supplied web resource changed. Costs $0.005 USDC. Use fresh402_register first for a free baseline when starting a new watch.
